newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse slows down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse slows down on profit-taking.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Tuesday 0.04 percent higher from Monday, with the major event being profit-taking on ONA group, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 533.98 points from 533.74 points from on Monday.
"Shareholders are anticipating on its (ONA's) good annual results," a broker at Wafa Bourse said.
ONA, the largest private conglomerate on the bourse, closed unchanged at 680 dirhams. Also unchanged was blue chip stock Wafabank at 685 dirhams.
The second biggest conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement rose 15 dirhams to close at 630 dirhams.
"Main trade focused on Wafabank, SNI and ONA which accounted for more than 27 million dirhams of the volume on the official market," he added.
Brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc dipped 15 dirhams to 1,980 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a blue chip stock, rose eight dirhams to trade at 488 dirhams.
Samir oil refinery, the country's main refinery, fell seven dirhams to 253.
Credit firm Credor which was floated in late December was up five dirhams to 615.
Traded volume on the official market was 59.9 million dirhams from 73.6 million on Monday.
